incomeType: Gross annual household income, all members, all taxable and non-taxable sources

CARE.name: California Alternate Rates for Energy
CARE.benefit: About 35% off electricity (on TOU-DR1) and 20% off gas
categoricalEligibility: Bureau of Indian Affairs General Assistance
CARE.categoricalNote: Enrolling in one of these programs can qualify a household without an income check. Confirm the current list on the SDG&E CARE page.

FERA.name: Family Electric Rate Assistance
FERA.note: For households of 3 or more whose income is above the CARE limit but at or below the FERA limit. Check SDG&E for 7+ person limits.
